extracted.name: Shoepeg Corn Salad
extracted.description: Jalapeno peppers lend a little heat to the homemade dressing for this creamy salad with shoepeg corn and tomatoes.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
2 (11 ounce) cans shoepeg corn, rinsed and drained
instruction_lines: Whisk mayonnaise, green onions, vinegar, jalapeno peppers, parsley, and olive oil together in a bowl until smooth; season with salt and pepper.
Gently stir corn and tomatoes into the dressing to coat. Transfer salad to a serving dish, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least 2 hours.
